crossRefs.note: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be…
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

parallels.note: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?
He summoned them, and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

translations.web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
translations.bsb: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
translations.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
translations.asv: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
